title: Text Editors [nano] + .bashrc
description:
# nano
`nano` is a simple terminal text editor. Way easier than vim.
```bash
nano filename
```
- Type to edit
- `Ctrl+O` to save
- `Ctrl+X` to exit

# .bashrc
`.bashrc` is a hidden file in your home directory that runs every time you open a terminal. You can add aliases, environment variables, and custom settings.
```bash
nano ~/.bashrc
```
